# Mobile UX File Plan

## Files to rewrite or add

- `scripts/ui/CreateView.js` — compose prompt, references, settings, and unified submission panel without fixed overlay.
- `scripts/ui/CreatePromptView.js` — retain prompt field/modes while exposing template entry point.
- `scripts/ui/CreatePromptTemplates.js` — new isolated template data/rendering module.
- `scripts/ui/CreateAssetTrayView.js` — mode-aware reference instructions and compact text-mode state.
- `scripts/ui/CreateReferenceGuide.js` — new concise teaching module for frames/reference media.
- `styles/sticky.css` — convert Generate from fixed overlay to normal-flow action panel behavior.
- `styles/metrics.css` — style unified cost/submission hierarchy.
- `styles/guidance.css` — new templates/reference-guide styling.
- `index.html` — link the new guidance stylesheet.
- browser smoke test — assert no cost/generate overlap on mobile and template/reference guide behavior.

## Constraints

- Full-file rewrites only.
- Tabs only.
- Every file <=120 lines.
- Existing provider readiness and controller submission guard must remain unchanged.
